arStrings.szText: The witches' story is complete. Continue to collect {icon:Witch_SeasonalCurrency, 2} {c_highlight}Restless Rot{/c} to master {c_highlight}Witchcraft{/c}.
Search for powerful {icon:Marker_Vendor_Lost_Witchcraft, 2} {c_highlight}Forgotten Altars{/c} to discover mysterious new {c_highlight}Witchcraft{/c}.
Seek out {c_highlight}Fugitive Heads{/c} during{icon:Marker_SME_Season, 2.5}{c_highlight}Headhunts{/c} and in {c_highlight}Rootholds{/c}.
Exchange these heads with {c_highlight}Gelena{/c} at the {icon:Marker_Bounties_TurnIn, 2.5}{c_highlight}Tree of Whispers{/c} for powerful new {c_highlight}Occult Gems{/c}.
